summary: BioMarin Pharmaceutical filed Form 8-K/A amending its original report to provide audited financial statements of Amicus Therapeutics (acquiree) and unaudited pro forma combined financials. The acquisition closed on April 27, 2026, with Amicus becoming a wholly-owned subsidiary via a merger with Merger Sub. Terms, including price per share or total consideration, were not restated; the original Merger Agreement dated December 19, 2025, governs. No board recommendation or advisor is named in this amendment. Filing fulfills Item 9.01 requirements. Watch for integration updates or potential earnout disclosures.
